`getBoundingClientRect()` reports the element’s border box position relative to the viewport. For `root>plain>pin`, Chromium reports `x=10` and `y=10`, and `root>plain` being `position: static` means it doesn’t introduce any special offset for the child’s absolutely-positioned coordinate system beyond the normal layout/containing block resolution. Therefore, the top-left corner of `root>plain>pin` renders at `(10, 10)` in CSS pixels.
